$comment: Maps the nine logical source names from the Gemini handoff to files in assets-source/. Reference boards are never cropped into game art. Filenames updated to the boards actually uploaded (several are .webp).

GAMEPLAY_REFERENCE.role: Master reference for palette, lighting and composition. Also the sampling source for HUD dark-fill colours.

VISTA_REFERENCE.role: PLACEHOLDER SLOT: the real Vista icon chooser never arrived. Currently points at the sparse gameplay mockup, which is reference-only and harmless.

PROTAGONIST_SOURCE.role: 12 protagonist poses in two rows. 10 are selected for hero.png; 2 redundant standing poses are dropped.

ICONS_SOURCE.role: NOT SUPPLIED. Blocks operations-tiles.png only. Everything else processes without it.

ENEMIES_ITEMS_SOURCE.role: Job Fail robots, Alert ground robots, Alert flying drones, Spool Runaway robots, command tokens, invincibility pickups.

EFFECTS_SOURCE.role: 7 golden aura rings, 5 colored stars, 8 sparkle particles, 4 impact-burst frames.

HUD_BLOCKS_SOURCE.role: Gameplay blocks, top HUD, Viewdata monitor, minimap, bottom HUD frames.

ENVIRONMENT_SOURCE.role: Isolated server racks, tape drives, cabinets, terminal workstation components, warning beacons, ventilation modules.

BACKGROUNDS_SOURCE.role: Three horizontal strips: sky, mountains and forest, datacenter silhouettes.
